sentences.text:
Petitio
 Through: Mr. Mishbah Bin Tariq, Advocate.
 versus
 State Nct Of Delhi And Anr. .....

Respond
 Through: Mr. Amit Ahlawat, App for State
 with Wsi Shakuntla, Ps Jamia N

Mr. Azhar Ali, Advocate for R-
 Coram:

Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No. 452/2025 of PS Jamia Nagar for offence under Section 376/506 IPC and 6 of POCSO Act on the ground that complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioner and they have now got married.
3. Learned APP accepts notice and seeks and is allowed four weeks to file status report.
4. On the next date, both sides shall address as to whether a case registered under POCSO Act can be quashed in such manner, which would defeat the very purpose of enactment.
